Sticky Notes Documentation

Welcome to the documentation for the Sticky Notes Django application. This guide covers the project structure, setup requirements, and the main modules used to create, display, update, and delete notes.

Documentation Contents

  • Project Modules

Project Summary

Sticky Notes is a lightweight Django web application that lets users manage short notes in a clean interface.

  • Django models for note storage
  • Model forms for creating and editing notes
  • Function-based views for CRUD operations
  • URL routing for the notes workflow
  • Templates and static styling for the user interface

How to Build the HTML Documentation

From the docs folder, run:

  • make.bat html on Windows
  • make html on Linux or macOS

The generated HTML output will be available in docs/build/html.
